08192 shaphah {sha:-fa:'}

字根型; TWOT - 2440; 動詞

欽定本 - high 1, stick out 1; 2

1) 掃清
   1a) (Niphal) 被風掃清 (#賽 13:2|)
   1b) (Pual) 被袒露 (#伯 33:21|)
record.edic_text:
08192 shaphah {shaw-faw'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2440; v

AV - high 1, stick out 1; 2

1) to sweep bare, scrape
   1a) (Niphal) to be wind-swept, be bare, be scraped barren (by wind)
   1b) (Pual) to be bare, be laid bare
